reviews.author: Sam Lo
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with this tow company. I ran out of gas on the highway, and I wasn't sure who to call so I looked up towing services in the area. The first call I made didn't do fuel delivery but he recommended this company to me. I called the number and the person who picked up explained the process and kept me updated with messages. He brought enough fuel to get me safely back on the road. He made a stressful situation much easier especially it being so late at night. If you ever find yourself stranded and need fuel delivery, I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Rosario Sagastume
reviews.text: Excellent customer service, Honest, Respectful, Very helpful, with a sense of responsibility making sure my safety was his priority, took his time to work on the steps to loose the spare tire came to be difficult because I didn't have the right tools at the moment so he remove the rip off tire and went to a place to get a new one for my car, after installing the tire he notice it was damaged so he asked me to fallow him to the place to replace the tire for a good one. Overall everything was at a reasonably priced. 100% recommended.

reviews.author: David Dumanski
reviews.text: Needed my motorcycle towed, he was quick to arrive, friendly, great pricing, very thorough with strapping it down and very accommodating. Would definitely use again!

reviews.author: emory gibson
reviews.text: This by far has been the best tow experience that I've received. He was prompt with his arrival time and very knowledgeable about the service I requested. I called for a jump but the issue was not resolved. He further assisted me with providing a tow to my residence. Overall great experience and he also offered advice to fix my problem.

reviews.text: I called him within 30 minutes. He was here to tow the car with no problem great price understandable. And willing to help.

reviews.text: My Fiancé and I had car troubles, we found Prince towing online looked at the reviews and instantly gave him a call, he was fast, efficient, extremely reassuring, very friendly! Thanks so much! We appreciate you I definitely recommend to any and everybody he’ll get the job done

reviews.author: Bill Anderson
reviews.text: We ran out of gas my bad lol. But chavar / prince 3c towing was there promptly as we were so close to the highway I put down a safety cone to keep him safe. The highway patrol showed up and added more protection. We thank you also you all are ausome

reviews.author: B ByT
reviews.text: Mr. Prince is hands down one of the most professional men & business owners, provides some of the most outstanding customer & cost effective services - have ever had. Very reasonable prices, he was on time and communicative. As soon as we set a time, he was actually earlier than expected. He ended up waiting on us actually; he was patient, understanding, & ready to roll!! Got to the location - had my vehicle hooked up in no time. Strapped it up securely, and was extremely knowledgeable, answering all my concerns/questions with ease and to my satisfaction. Even offered some insight, information, and knowledge about or specific vehicle - which we didn't know, and when we looked it up - it was exactly what he took the time out to share - to help out, that. 1st Triple AAA wouldn't tow it from our home address, bc it was a "home address" or tow it bc the plates weren't current (on a car we haven't been driving). He saved us over 200$+, compared to a tow service out of wilson, nc. The tow company, they, were attempting to charge us over 300$ + dollars to tow from the same location to the same designation - as Mr. Prince towed. Mr. Prince answered promptly our call to service - let us know his rate, and availability - we set a time, and he took very good care of us. He was mindful and careful with our ride. We're completely satisfied around the board. Mr. Chavar Prince, thank you Good Sir; for being respectful, kind, and courteous. Excellent service. Will be using you anytime, or every time we require any towing services, around ENC. Even over Triple AAA - your wait time was way lesser, and so much less red tape and nonsense that comes along with getting a tow through AAA. Only have to talk to one person and you show up. You came highly recommended and eye highly recommend you / your services to the public and those who need towing services at a reasonable and budget-friendly rate/price. Keep up the good work & thank you again !! Keep being a blessing to others and you'll continue to be blessed - as you know ! Peace.
